subject: Animation
title: Aardman vs Laika: Two Philosophies
description: A micro-lesson that makes Aardman vs Laika: Two Philosophies usable.

hook.text: Aardman and Laika are the two biggest stop-motion studios today, but their philosophies differ sharply.

buildup.text: Aardman embraces handmade imperfection. Fingerprints in the clay are a feature, not a flaw.

discovery.text: Laika uses 3D printing and digital compositing to push stop-motion toward cinematic realism.

twist.text: Both approaches have won Academy Awards and critical acclaim. Neither is objectively better.

climax.text: Together, they prove stop-motion has room for both warmth and spectacle in the modern age.

punchline.text: Two studios, two philosophies, one beautiful art form.

quiz.question: How do Aardman and Laika differ in their approach to stop-motion?
options: Aardman uses CGI while Laika uses clay
Aardman embraces handmade imperfection while Laika uses 3D printing for cinematic precision
Aardman makes feature films while Laika makes only shorts
